reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: Wanted to love this so much but for some reason I get a red rash on my face. I think I am allergic to the product but maybe is just my sensitive skin. My mother and friends use it without a problem and they love it. I decided to use it on my body instead and it leaves my skin so supple love it for the body.
reviews.zh: 本來好想好鍾意呢款，但係唔知點解我面上會起紅疹。我諗我可能對產品敏感，不過都可能只係我嘅皮膚比較敏感。我媽媽同朋友用就冇問題，而且好鍾意。我決定改用喺身體上，用完皮膚好軟滑，身體用就好鍾意。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: I love it, I thought it would be more thicker in texture because when it comes out from the tube it gives out more slimy texture but once you apply it to your face it dissolves very quickly, its been 2 weeks and i can visibly see my skin getting better, i dont know if it’s solidly this product doing it or combination of other products but it definitely helped me with my redness and other skin problems ive been having, 처음 짰을때 엄청 두껍게 발릴줄알았는데 막상 얼굴에 펴발르면은 아주 빨리 흡수됩니다, 2주째 사용중인데 피부 트러블이 사라지는게 눈에 띄게 보여요
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！原本以為質地會更稠，因為從管入面擠出嚟嗰陣比較黏膩，但係一塗喺面上就好快溶開。用咗兩個星期，睇得到皮膚有改善。我唔肯定係淨係呢款產品嘅效果，還是同其他產品一齊用嘅組合效果，但係佢肯定幫我改善咗面紅同其他皮膚問題。第一次擠出嚟嗰陣，我以為會塗得好厚，但係一抹喺面上就好快吸收，用咗兩個星期，皮膚問題消失嘅情況明顯可見。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: So I have Combo Oily Skin and unfortunately this ended up making my hormonal chin/jaw acne worse. The rest of my face loved it!! It absorbed really well and definitely gave that glass skin look but unfortunately the lower half of my face did not, don’t know if anyone else with hormonal acne had the same experience but that was my reaction. I would still say it’s worth a shot if you’re on the fence about trying it, you never know if might work out for you even though it didn’t work out for me. For example I gave mine to my mom and she absolutely loves it says it absorbs so quickly and she said she even saw improvement with her pores.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚係混合偏油，但可惜呢款產品令我嘅荷爾蒙引致嘅下巴／下顎痘痘惡化咗。我面嘅其他部位好鍾意佢！！吸收好好，確實有玻璃肌效果，但可惜我嘅下半面就唔係咁。唔知有冇其他荷爾蒙痘痘嘅人有同樣經驗，但呢個係我嘅反應。如果你仲係猶豫要唔要試，我都會話值得一試，因為即使佢唔啱我，都唔知會唔會啱你。例如我將自己嗰份俾咗媽媽，佢好鍾意，話吸收得好快，佢連毛孔都見到改善。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text:
It has been on my skincare wishlist for a while and I am really happy I got it^^ it has alot of product so a small amout goes a long way,I learned that the hard way xd 
Anyway,its a very good product,doesn't has fragrance which I always appreciate,isnt too sticky,oily or runny.
I will say that I tried this product with other products (in the past 3 days) that helped me with skin texture I had problems with around my forehead^^
Tldr,very helpful and has a great texture.
reviews.zh:
呢款一直喺我嘅護膚心水清單入面，好開心終於買到咗^^ 產品份量好多，所以少少就夠用，呢點係我親身試過先知道嘅 xd
總之，係一款非常好嘅產品，冇香味，我一向好鍾意呢點，質地唔會太黏、太油或者太稀。
我想講嘅係，我喺過去三日同其他產品一齊用，幫我改善咗額頭位嘅皮膚質感問題^^
Tldr，好有幫助，質地好好。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: I was really surprised by this product because it wasn't sticky on my face. I would really recommend for any skin type. As an acne prone skin myself, it did not make my acne worst (some product tend to to that) and someone else with dried skin also tried it and it also did very well on her. There is almost no sent to it.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品令我好驚喜，因為塗喺面上唔會黏。我真心推薦畀任何膚質嘅人。我自己係易生暗瘡嘅皮膚，佢冇令我嘅暗瘡變嚴重（有啲產品會咁）；另外有位乾性皮膚嘅朋友都試過，用喺佢身上效果都好好。幾乎冇香味。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: This is one of my holy grail moisturizers. It’s fungal acne safe and it contains snail mucin which is moisturizing and helps with recovery. It is very light so it’s better for the warmer seasons as you would need to use another moisturizer in the winter. I use squalane oil on top afterwards in the winter for extra hydration.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我嘅心水保濕霜之一。佢對真菌痘（fungal acne）安全，而且含有蝸牛黏液（snail mucin），可以保濕，亦有助修復。佢質地好輕，所以更啱天氣暖和嘅季節用，因為冬天你需要再用另一款保濕霜。冬天我之後會再塗角鯊烷油，補充額外水分。

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: YES MY CURRENT FAV AND NEW HG. im in loveee with this and could not be more obsessed. i have never glowed this much in my whole life. its intensely moisturizing and hydrating while being lightweight and leaves your skin soft and glowy and not sticky. ive been sick for the past couple of days but never glowed more. i got kinda lazy during the AM and found i can just apply this and sunscreen and my skin will be fine. 10/10! WRP
reviews.zh: 係呀，我而家最愛，亦係新嘅 HG（心水產品）！我真係好愛佢，迷到不得了。我一生人都冇咁有光澤過。佢保濕力好強，同時好輕盈，令皮膚柔軟、有光澤，而且唔會黏。雖然我過去幾日病咗，但光澤感反而更加好。我早上有少少懶，發現只需要塗呢款再塗防曬，皮膚已經好好。10/10！WRP

reviews.shade: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence 100 mL
reviews.text: [Review from K-beauty tester] Some people may not enjoy the thicker "sticky" feeling of this essence, but I personally liked using it because I thought it was very moisturizing for my skin especially during the winter and for my night routine. I will purchase this product for my mom who likes using snail skincare products!
reviews.zh: 【韓國美妝測試員評價】有啲人可能唔鍾意呢款精華較厚、「黏黏」嘅質感，但我個人好鍾意用，因為我覺得佢對我嘅皮膚保濕力好強，特別係冬天同晚間護膚嗰陣。我會幫我媽媽買呢款產品，佢好鍾意用蝸牛護膚產品！
